'''''Tillandsia bergeri''''' is a [[species]] of [[flowering plant]] in the family [[Bromeliaceae]].<ref name=POWO>{{cite taxon |POWO |id=253621-2 |title=''Tillandsia bergeri'' Mez |access-date=July 14, 2026}}</ref><ref name=COL>{{Catalogue of Life |id=56X9M |title=''Tillandsia bergeri'' Mez |access-date=July 14, 2026}}</ref> This species is [[Native plant|native]] to [[Brazil]].<ref name=ROD>{{cite journal |last1=Martinelli |first1=Gustavo |last2=Vieira |first2=Cláudia Magalhães |last3=Gonzalez |first3=Marcos |last4=Leitman |first4=Paula |last5=Piratininga |first5=Andréa |last6=Costa |first6=Andrea Ferreira da |last7=Forzza |first7=Rafaela Campostrini |title=Bromeliaceae da Mata Atlântica Brasileira: lista de espécies, distribuição e conservação |journal=Rodriguésia |date=January 2008 |volume=59 |issue=1 |pages=209–258 |jstor=23499386 |doi=10.1590/2175-7860200859114 |trans-title=Bromeliaceae of the brazilian Atlantic Forest: checklist, distribution and conservation |language=pt-BR|doi-access=free}}</ref>
